declarations.description:
Navigation trail. Every light-DOM child is one item, typically a `c2-link-button` with an `href`, and the last one
is the current page: it is marked `aria-current="page"` (through `selected` on a link button) and styled as text.
A separator is drawn between items, a chevron by default or whatever is placed in the `separator` slot. The trail
stays on one row: when the items do not fit the available width, some collapse behind an ellipsis, in priority
order: the current page is always shown, then the first item, then the items closest to the current page while room
remains. `max-items` caps how many are shown even when there is room. Clicking the ellipsis reveals every item
(wrapping if needed).
declarations.name: Breadcrumb

cssProperties.description: Space between an item and its separator.
cssProperties.name: --c2-breadcrumb--gap

cssProperties.description: Icon size and font size of the separator.
cssProperties.name: --c2-breadcrumb__separator--size

slots.description: The items, in order. Use `c2-link-button` for links; any element works for the current page.
Custom separator, cloned between every pair of items (text such as `/`, or an icon).
slots.name: separator

members.name: maxItems
members.description: Upper bound on visible items (the first, then the last ones behind an ellipsis). `0` lets the width decide alone.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

members.name: measuring
members.description: Render every item invisibly to measure it; the next render shows the trail that fits.

members.name: collapsed
members.description: Collapsed layout: whether the first item is shown, and how many trailing items (including the current page).

members.name: items
members.description: The item elements, in order (everything except the separator content).

members.name: assignItems
members.description: Gives every item its own slot so each can sit in a list item with its separator, and marks the last as current.

members.name: measure
members.description:
Reads the natural width of every item (all rendered, invisible) and decides what fits on one row, in priority
order: the current page always, then the first item, then the middle items closest to the current page.
`max-items` caps the count. Runs before paint, so there is no flicker.

attributes.name: max-items
attributes.description: Upper bound on visible items (the first, then the last ones behind an ellipsis). `0` lets the width decide alone.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.
